story-1774227030873.title: On the dunes
story-1774227030873.author: Ethan
story-1774227030873.content: My brother and I went to the sand dunes and took some photos with the sunset. We admired the sunset. We build each other up spiritually, and become better together.

story-1774238193975.title: My Testimony
story-1774238193975.author: Austin Brackney
story-1774238193975.content: I know that my Savior lives. He has helped me throughout my life, and has never left me. I know He loves me and so does Heavenly Father.
